heading: Release owner checklist

heading: Release owner checklist

heading: P0 — Preserve progress and establish a usable benchmark
text: **F02 — Reconcile this amendment with the living register and current code.** Owner: Scout + FORGE owner. Map each task to existing work, actual paths and latest receipts; retain original task IDs; mark done only with evidence. Deliverable: delta register, no duplicate backlog.

heading: P0 — Preserve progress and establish a usable benchmark
text: **F03 — Complete the value-free coverage audit, subject to its separate approval.** Owner: data owner + evaluator. Existing proposed scope remains retained indexes/spans October 7, 2025–January 13, 2026. Exact IDs, roles, team bindings, schemas, target units, date/game counts and missingness. Do not reopen mixed outcome files. Deliverable: concrete cohort proposal and authorization-ready manifest. Research request does not itself authorize this data audit.

heading: P0 — Preserve progress and establish a usable benchmark
text: **F04 — Define opportunity population, targets and label contract.** Owner: FORGE + evaluator. Include verified nonappearances; distinguish missing/zero; pin provider definitions, revisions, forecast horizons and conditionality. Depends F03 for actual feasibility. Exit: each head has an explicit population, time boundary and fallback.

heading: P0 — Preserve progress and establish a usable benchmark
text: **F05 — Freeze finite benchmark protocol.** Owner: evaluator. Exact sources/cohort, lag/availability policy, temporal partitions, candidate budget, primary scores, practical gain criterion, subgroup checks and stop rules. Preserve exposed-history labels. Exit: independently reviewed manifest before execution.

heading: P0 — Preserve progress and establish a usable benchmark
text: **F06 — Reproduce baseline and existing candidates on admitted broader data.** Owner: FORGE. First run is a coverage/benchmark repair, not a new algorithm sweep. Report matched rows and exclusions. Depends F03–F05 and execution approval. Exit: immutable reproducible forecasts and target-specific comparisons.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F07 — Decompose exposure versus rate error.** Owner: skater-model worker. Four ablations from Section B; forecast exposure out of sample; oracle diagnostic kept separate. Depends F06. Exit: identify the next change from evidence rather than speculation.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F08 — Participation and role evidence model.** Owner: data/role worker. Versioned pregame evidence, probabilistic role scenarios, source freshness and contradictory reports. Separate PP team opportunity from deployment, and test early versus late authentic information cutoffs when feasible. Calibrate only on an authentic risk set. Conditional forecasts may proceed separately while unavailable history is disclosed.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F09 — SOG/HIT/BLK rate challenger.** Owner: skater-model worker. Compare simple shrunk exposure model and one modest context extension; reuse existing implementation where present. Exit: paired mean accuracy, calibration/bias, subgroup/concentration and latency results.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F10 — Rink/era observation-model experiment.** Owner: separate modeling worker after F06. Recent training-only venue effects; recorded-count evaluation; verify SHOT versus SOG and shooting-team BLOCK versus defending-player BLK mappings; no historic coefficient copying. Avoid simultaneous edits to F09. Exit: ablation shows whether venue adds useful signal beyond player/team/context.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F11 — Goals/assists/PPP components.** Owner: scoring-model worker. Start from direct target means; compare opportunity + rate decomposition. Test shot-volume/finishing or assist components only with verified labels. PPP incorporates PP exposure/role uncertainty; no PP evidence means unknown role, not zero PPP. Exit: per-head gains after coherence checks.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F12 — PIM event-severity challenger.** Owner: skater-model worker. Verify penalty-type accounting first; compare simple shrunk baseline against one compound/hurdle candidate. No arbitrary outlier deletion. Exit: full-tail and typical-game performance reported separately, promotion based on declared target.

heading: P1 — Improve opportunity and high-utility count forecasts
text: **F13 — Coherent goalie components.** Owner: goalie-model worker. Conditional minutes/SA baseline, stopping component, start/relief state where support exists, derived SV/GA, ratio contract and independent W/SO gates. pStart must cover the complete team-game candidate set (with an unknown/other state if needed); official W/SO marginal probability heads can precede a full simulator. Exit: reconciled per-component evaluation, honest unsupported heads and no hidden regression in blended goalie scores.

heading: P2 — Earn sophistication and connect it to lineup value
text: **F14 — Test one dynamic adaptation mechanism.** Owner: FORGE. Recency or state-space challenger, not unlimited half-life search; subgroup tests for trades, role changes, rookies and returns. Depends broad baseline and verified feature clocks.

heading: P2 — Earn sophistication and connect it to lineup value
text: **F15 — Calibrate distributions and uncertainty.** Owner: evaluator/modeler. Mean-fixed distribution comparison, then joint exposure uncertainty; residual dispersion and zero/tail checks. Optional time-adaptive interval calibration is a separate policy needing its own test. Exit: interval usefulness and coverage, not only wider intervals.

heading: P2 — Earn sophistication and connect it to lineup value
text: **F16 — Benchmark a bounded nonlinear challenger and/or regularized ensemble.** Owner: FORGE. Only after simple baselines; identical pregame features; chronological out-of-fold predictions for combination weights. No blend-improvement guarantee, no final-block weight tuning. Exit: improvement survives selection and reconciliation cost.

heading: P2 — Earn sophistication and connect it to lineup value
text: **F17 — RSO/Start Chart decision replay.** Owner: consumer/evaluator pair. Same legal solver, points/category rules and actionable candidates; report crowded-day start/bench gains and net complete-swap gains. Distinguish simulator from authentic account replay. Depends admitted forecasts and consumer contracts.

heading: P2 — Earn sophistication and connect it to lineup value
text: **F18 — Next-10/20 scheduled-game aggregation.** Owner: FORGE. Sum the next 10/20 scheduled-game means all issued at the same forecast origin; keep each later refresh as a separate version. For uncertainty, model shared role/availability and schedule dependence. Exit: horizon-specific calibration, no silent switch to next appearances.

heading: P2 — Earn sophistication and connect it to lineup value
text: **F19 — Accountability dashboard.** Owner: independent UI worker after schema freeze. Target/version/baseline, sample and date coverage, signed-error histogram, loss through time, calibration, subgroups, excluded rows and test-status badges. Display local/research/shadow/deployed distinctly.

heading: P0 operational track — Make future confirmation reliable

Export exact runner/model/input-schema/guard pins and admissible nonsecret fixture package; verify environment parity, clock, dependencies, duplicate prevention and immutable receipts. Credentials or expanded access need their own approved setup. This is future work: it does not reopen October 14's passed window or authorize an automatic retry.

heading: P0 operational track — Make future confirmation reliable
text: **F21 — Freeze and issue prospective shadow forecasts.** Owner: sole capture executor. Freeze candidate choices and rolling-update policy before permitted windows, then evaluate with genuine source times. Unsupported heads remain conditional/unavailable. Do not let UI pressure turn research into a production claim.

heading: P0 operational track — Make future confirmation reliable
text: **F22 — Per-head release review and rollback.** Owner: independent reviewer + product owner. Data integrity, predictive evidence, coverage, calibration, consumer readback, latency and rollback. Promote supported heads/populations independently when justified; no entire-model blanket approval.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements

Report requested and paired populations so exclusion of hard cases cannot manufacture improvement.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-3 Compare native FORGE, expanding/recency baselines, shrinkage/exposure, count and probability families in predeclared finite stages. Add justified boosted trees/ensembles only after coverage and compute permit; test team Elo/Glicko only as a dated contextual-feature ablation, never as the whole player model. heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-4 Select expected means with squared error/MSE or appropriate proper distribution scores, never solely MAE. Report MAE/RMSE, bias, proper count/probability losses, calibration, interval coverage/width and coverage together. New loss policies get new reviewed versions; do not reinterpret the accepted MAE-selected historical pilot.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-5 Evaluate paired, baseline-covered cohorts per target/horizon/conditioning/evidence class, including chronological stability, game/slate counts and defensible clustered/time-block uncertainty. Preserve missing forecasts and coverage differences; keep raw units separate, mark zero-denominator skill undefined, and show unsupported rookie/trade/role-change segments as not estimable.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-6 Extend the existing accountability UI with time-series loss/coverage trends, signed/absolute-error histograms, per-target/horizon/version leaderboards, baseline skill, paired differences/sample sizes/uncertainty and supported cohort filters. Expose evidence stage, missingness and abstentions; no generic accuracy percentage or repeatedly mined held-out leaderboard as a promotion claim.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-7 Measure lineup and drop/add net decision gains/regret with identical frozen scoring, roster, eligibility, locks, waiver/transaction/allowance and acquisition-cost rules; preserve matching issued inputs, shared-game dependence, legality and excluded-decision counts. Keep conditional BLK proxies and sensitivity comparisons distinct from realized roster/transaction gains.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-8 Predeclare promotion and rollback criteria before final evaluation: sample/coverage floors, meaningful baseline skill, calibration/coherence and subgroup limits, original-input/issuance integrity, operating bounds and hash-pinned fallback. Independent evaluator seals final feedback; one declared final decision, new unexposed protocol for further selection, and separate release authority.

heading: October 14 ongoing candidate comparison and accountability requirements
text: OCT14-COMP-9 Inventory and reuse existing evaluation/storage/dashboard/accuracy/promotion/rollout contracts before adding a duplicate stack or migration. Implement only accepted gaps with focused tests/review. Preserve the original dated October 14 17:30 Eastern freeze and separate 17:50/18:15/18:30 live guards/BLK fallback as historical requirements, including missed-window handling; any future scheduled run, acquisition, publish or deployment needs its own approved bounds.
